snippet.title: Postcards At Our Pace
snippet.description:
Two retirees, one dog, no rush. Slow-travel and full-time retirement adventures from Greg, Tammy, and Brody — starting with a trip from Texas to Panama.

We're Greg and Tammy. After thirty-plus years of work — Tammy in the classroom, Greg in software engineering and cybersecurity — we're selling our Texas house, packing up our dog Brody, and traveling full-time. Panama is stop one. After that, we don't know — and we're learning to like it that way.

This channel follows the move and everything that comes after: the visa process, the dog quarantine, the first time we cook dinner in a Chame kitchen, the morning Tammy figures out how to keep her skincare routine in a country she's never lived in. Slow travel in retirement, filmed by two people who are working it out as they go.

Want to brighten our day? Buy us a coffee! ☕🍵
https://buymeacoffee.com/postcardsatourpace

Subscribe and come along. Hit the bell so you don't miss a postcard.

snippet.title: Sailing Supernova
snippet.description: Hey, we are Yvette and Darcy. Join us on our trip around the world. Together with our castaway cat, Captain Coconut, we go to some of the most remote places in our newly refit Sunreef 62 sailing catamaran. We release weekly up to date real-time videos every Friday on Youtube, about all the adventures of the previous week - including free diving, scuba, spear fishing, travel, boat life, exploring and of course sailing! We also release an extra video every single week on Patreon. If we are in an area near you then let us know, we would love to say hi. It would be awesome if you could subscribe, comment and like any videos you enjoy. We both work hard and put a bunch of effort in to making the weekly videos, but at the end of the day we feel lucky to be doing what we love and what we have always dreamed of. Hope to see you out on the water one day or on a beach near you!

snippet.title: GrowFitFL
snippet.description:
Grow Food NOT Lawns.

I'm Jermaine. Husband, father of four, and a man of God. I who'd rather feed my family off my own land than mow grass. 150+ edible plants on a quarter acre in West Central Florida.

This channel is about a family standing on its own. Growing food. Health. Putting it up. Getting ready for hurricanes, power outages and empty shelves. Saving seed. Raising children who know how to work. And the faith and discipline that hold it together.

20 years growing food, 11 of them in Florida. 12 years as a certified personal trainer. Author of Grow Food NOT Lawns, The Florida Perennial Garden and Discipline. 

I won't tell you there's only one way. Just what worked in my yard, what didn't, and what I'd do if I started over.

New video every Sunday.

Join the GrowFitFL Club: members.growfitfl.com/pricing
Free 5-lesson course, no card: members.growfitfl.com/reason-why
Same Club on Patreon: patreon.com/GrowFitFL
Books: growfoodnotlawnsbook.com
Store: growfitfl.com

snippet.title: LIMA-TANGO Survival
snippet.description:
LIMA-TANGO SURVIVAL….THE BEST GEAR WHEN YOU ARE MOST VULNERABLE.

Disaster strikes without warning. When it does, do you really want cheap, disposable, one-size-fits-none gear that is designed for something other than survival? Or do you want rugged, tactical, field-tested survival gear?

WHO WE ARE: At LIMA-TANGO, a combat veteran owned and operated business, we are all about high-performance survival gear that stands up to the toughest conditions. Drawing on our military survival S.E.R.E. training and expertise, we deliver equipment designed for reliability and durability, so you are never left vulnerable.
 
OUR MISSION: To provide the best survival gear when you are most vulnerable. Most survival kits are pre-made overseas and re-sold with disposable, cheap, unreliable gear. We think through multiple survival scenarios and source trusted name brands. We design and assemble each kit based on quality, usability, and durability right here the USA!

Doomsday Archives is original long-form speculative survival fiction grounded in real-world research.

Every episode on this channel pairs a fictional Zombie outbreak scenario with documented engineering, history, biology, supply-chain data, and geography. Our aim is to ask: what would actually happen if the Zombie Outbreak arrived — and what would it take in real preparation, cost, and time to survive it.

New episodes weekly. Creator: Doomsday Archives. Story leads and scripts: original work.

All stories are dramatized works of fiction. Locations, scenarios, and characters are imagined.

snippet.title: Casey Jones - Professional Engineer
snippet.description:
I cover exciting topics for bridges, buildings and other interesting civil engineering projects around the world.  I also cover topics that interest me in the areas of geology and space exploration.

I am a geotechnical engineer who has been in practice since 1987.  I am a licensed professional engineer (Missouri, Kansas, Iowa, Arkansas, Oklahoma and Texas) and a licensed  professional geologist (Missouri and Kansas).  I have experience in foundation design, dam and levee design and construction and construction phase testing of bridge foundations.  The primary purpose of this channel is to cover interesting issues associated with design and construction of infrastructure projects.

The use of the information set forth in this YouTube video is at the viewer's own risk. Any information should be considered neither technical nor engineering advice. Users should consult with the relevant professionals for specific advice related to their situation.
